crossRefs.note: For they covered the surface of the whole earth, so that the land was darkened, and they ate every herb of the land…
But the wheat and the spelt were not struck, for they had not grown up.
What the swarming locust has left, the great locust has eaten. What the great locust has left, the grasshopper has…
I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, the great locust, the grasshopper, and the…

translations.web: and they shall cover the surface of the earth, so that one won’t be able to see the earth. They shall eat the residue of that which has escaped, which remains to you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which grows for you out of the field.
translations.bsb: They will cover the face of the land so that no one can see it. They will devour whatever is left after the hail and eat every tree that grows in your fields.
translations.kjv: And they shall cover the face of the earth, that one cannot be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:
translations.asv: and they shall cover the face of the earth, so that one shall not be able to see the earth: and they shall eat the residue of that which is escaped, which remaineth unto you from the hail, and shall eat every tree which groweth for you out of the field:
